payload.summary: A silent HTTP 400 on long or single-character queries, and a unit-less creatinine range message
payload.detail: (a) api/search/universal/route.ts:36 is z.string().trim().min(2).max(200); a 614-char query 400s with no message anywhere on screen, and a single character 400s the same way. (b) The Serum creatinine field rejects 1.02 with 'Enter 15-3000.' - the only numeric field whose range message carries no unit (CrCl says mL/min, QTc says ms). 1.02 is an ordinary mg/dL value and the bound shown is the umol/L one. Carried forward from the refutation of #WFARS3.
